# Clavis 3.7.7

## 📖 New: Clavis Help

- **https://clavisenc.com/help.html** — step-by-step guides with annotated screenshots for every feature: getting started, encrypting and opening files, watch folders, notes, cloud folders, sharing, backups, previous versions, the command line and settings.

## 🛠 Fixed

- The **Sharing** window no longer cuts off its text and buttons or shows a sideways scroll bar.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now).
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
